.special-course{padding:96px 0;background:
radial-gradient(circle at 80% 15%,rgba(216,177,94,.11),transparent 28%),
linear-gradient(180deg,#101011,#0c0c0d);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.special-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.92fr 1.08fr;gap:70px;align-items:center}
.special-poster{position:relative}
.special-poster img{border-radius:28px;border:1px solid rgba(216,177,94,.22);box-shadow:0 35px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.55)}
.special-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:7px 11px;border:1px solid rgba(216,177,94,.38);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(216,177,94,.08);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--gold2)}
.special-copy h2{font-family:Georgia,"Noto Serif TC",serif;font-size:clamp(42px,5vw,64px);line-height:1.03;margin:18px 0 14px}
.special-intro{font-size:15px;color:#b8b3aa;max-width:650px;margin-bottom:28px}
.special-team{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin:26px 0}
.team-box{padding:18px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.025)}
.team-box>span{display:block;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:11px}
.team-line{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.team-line:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.team-line b{font-size:13px;color:#eee}
.team-line small{font-size:11px;color:#8f8a83;text-align:right}
.special-benefits{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;margin:24px 0}
.benefit{padding:14px 13px;border-radius:15px;background:#151517;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.benefit b{display:block;font-size:12px;color:#f0ebe3;margin-bottom:4px}
.benefit span{font-size:10px;color:#8f8a83}
.special-price{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:24px;margin-top:28px;padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.special-price small{display:block;color:#7f7a74;font-size:10px;margin-bottom:4px}
.special-price strong{font-size:36px;color:var(--gold2);line-height:1}
.special-price .btn{white-space:nowrap}
@media(max-width:980px){.special-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:42px}.special-poster{max-width:760px;margin:auto}.special-team{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media(max-width:640px){.special-course{padding:78px 0}.special-team{grid-template-columns:1fr}.special-benefits{grid-template-columns:1fr}.special-price{align-items:stretch;flex-direction:column}.special-price .btn{width:100%}}


.faculty-wrap{background:#0e0e10;border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.faculty-intro{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:48px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:42px}
.faculty-intro h2{font-family:Georgia,"Noto Serif TC",serif;font-size:clamp(38px,5vw,60px);line-height:1.08;margin:12px 0 0;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.faculty-intro p{max-width:500px;margin:0;color:#aaa69f}
.faculty-group{margin-top:34px}
.faculty-group-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;margin-bottom:24px}
.faculty-group-head span{font-size:18px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--gold2);line-height:1.2}
.faculty-group-head:after{content:"";height:1px;flex:1;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(216,177,94,.35),transparent)}
.faculty-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px}
.faculty-card{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#171719,#111113);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;transition:.3s;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
.faculty-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:rgba(216,177,94,.32)}
.faculty-photo{aspect-ratio:4/5;overflow:hidden;background:#111}
.faculty-photo img{height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top;transition:.5s}
.faculty-card:hover .faculty-photo img{transform:scale(1.025)}
.faculty-body{padding:22px}
.faculty-role{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:5px}
.faculty-body h3{font-size:28px;margin:0 0 4px}
.faculty-title{font-size:21px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.25;color:var(--gold2);margin:2px 0 7px;letter-spacing:.02em}.faculty-en{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#8e8a84;margin-bottom:14px}
.faculty-body p{font-size:13px;color:#a6a19a;margin:0 0 16px;min-height:64px}
.faculty-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px}
.faculty-tags span{font-size:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:5px 9px;color:#bbb6ae}
.faculty-course{margin-top:16px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:11px;color:#7f7a74}
.faculty-course b{display:block;color:#e9e3da;font-size:12px;margin-top:3px}
.consultant{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#17150f,#111113)}
.consultant .faculty-role{color:#f2c878}
.consultant:hover{border-color:rgba(242,200,120,.38)}
.faculty-note{margin-top:42px;padding:24px 26px;border:1px solid rgba(216,177,94,.2);border-radius:18px;background:rgba(216,177,94,.035);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:30px;align-items:center}
.faculty-note strong{font-family:Georgia,"Noto Serif TC",serif;font-size:22px;color:#f0ebe3;flex-shrink:0}
.faculty-note span{font-size:12px;color:#918c85;flex:1;max-width:none;text-align:right;white-space:nowrap}
@media(max-width:980px){.faculty-intro{align-items:start;flex-direction:column}.faculty-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.faculty-card:last-child{grid-column:1/-1}.faculty-note{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.faculty-note span{text-align:left;white-space:normal;width:100%}}
@media(max-width:640px){.faculty-group-head span{font-size:15px}.faculty-title{font-size:19px}.faculty-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.faculty-card:last-child{grid-column:auto}.faculty-note{padding:20px}}


.consultant-feature{
  padding:78px 0 92px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%,rgba(216,177,94,.10),transparent 38%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#0d0d0f,#111113);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
}
.consultant-feature-inner{
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  border:1px solid rgba(216,177,94,.22);
  border-radius:28px;padding:58px 60px;
  background:linear-gradient(120deg,rgba(216,177,94,.07),rgba(255,255,255,.015) 45%,rgba(216,177,94,.025));
  box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.24);
}
.consultant-feature-inner:before{
  content:"";position:absolute;width:420px;height:420px;
  right:-180px;top:-220px;border:1px solid rgba(216,177,94,.12);border-radius:50%;
}
.consultant-feature-top{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:60px;align-items:end;
}
.consultant-feature-kicker{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:var(--gold2);
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.18em;margin-bottom:18px;
}
.consultant-feature-kicker:before{content:"";width:30px;height:1px;background:var(--gold)}
.consultant-feature h2{
  font-family:Georgia,"Noto Serif TC",serif;
  font-size:clamp(38px,5vw,62px);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.04em;margin:0;
}
.consultant-feature h2 em{
  display:block;font-style:normal;color:var(--gold2);margin-top:7px;
}
.consultant-feature-copy{color:#aca79e;font-size:14px;margin:0;max-width:520px}
.consultant-feature-copy b{color:#eee}
.consultant-feature-grid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:38px;
}
.consultant-mini{
  padding:20px 22px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;background:rgba(12,12,14,.52);
}
.consultant-mini small{
  display:block;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.15em;color:#746f68;margin-bottom:8px;
}
.consultant-mini strong{display:block;font-size:20px;color:#f0ebe3;margin-bottom:4px}
.consultant-mini span{display:block;color:var(--gold2);font-size:13px;font-weight:700}
.consultant-feature-foot{
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:30px;align-items:center;
  margin-top:30px;padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
}
.consultant-feature-foot p{
  margin:0;font-family:Georgia,"Noto Serif TC",serif;font-size:21px;color:#ded8ce;
}
.consultant-feature-foot span{color:#77726b;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.05em}
@media(max-width:980px){
  .consultant-feature-top{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:24px}
  .consultant-feature-inner{padding:46px 38px}
}
@media(max-width:640px){
  .consultant-feature{padding:56px 0 68px}
  .consultant-feature-inner{padding:34px 22px;border-radius:22px}
  .consultant-feature-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .consultant-feature-foot{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}
}




.course-bridge{
  position:relative;
  padding:34px 0 38px;
  background:transparent;
  overflow:visible;
}
.course-bridge:before{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  left:50%;
  top:-42px;
  width:70%;
  height:120px;
  transform:translateX(-50%);
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,rgba(216,177,94,.035),transparent 68%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.course-bridge:after{
  content:none;
}
.course-bridge-inner{
  width:min(var(--max),calc(100% - 48px));
  margin:auto;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1.22fr .78fr;
  gap:72px;
  align-items:center;
  position:relative;
  z-index:1;
}
.bridge-kicker{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:12px;
  margin-bottom:12px;
  color:var(--gold2);
  font-size:9px;
  letter-spacing:.18em;
  font-weight:700;
}
.bridge-kicker:before{
  content:"";
  width:24px;
  height:1px;
  background:rgba(216,177,94,.65);
}
.bridge-title{
  margin:0;
  font-family:Georgia,"Noto Serif TC",serif;
  font-size:clamp(32px,3.55vw,47px);
  line-height:1.08;
  letter-spacing:-.03em;
  color:#eee9e1;
}
.bridge-title .bridge-main-line{
  display:block;
  white-space:nowrap;
  color:#eee9e1;
}
.bridge-title span{
  display:block;
  color:var(--gold2);
  margin-top:6px;
}
.bridge-copy{
  margin:0;
  max-width:500px;
  color:#a9a49c;
  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.9;
}
.bridge-copy b{color:#e8e2d9}
.bridge-next{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:9px;
  margin-top:13px;
  color:var(--gold2);
  font-size:10px;
  letter-spacing:.07em;
}
.bridge-next i{
  display:grid;
  place-items:center;
  width:24px;
  height:24px;
  border:1px solid rgba(216,177,94,.22);
  border-radius:50%;
  font-style:normal;
  font-size:12px;
}
@media(max-width:980px){
  .course-bridge{
    padding:30px 0 34px;
  }
  .course-bridge-inner{
    grid-template-columns:1fr;
    gap:18px;
  }
  .bridge-title .bridge-main-line{
    white-space:normal;
  }
  .bridge-copy{max-width:720px}
}
@media(max-width:640px){
  .course-bridge{
    padding:26px 0 30px;
  }
  .course-bridge-inner{
    width:min(var(--max),calc(100% - 28px));
  }
  .bridge-title{
    font-size:31px;
  }
}




.quiz-section{padding:100px 0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%,rgba(216,177,94,.08),transparent 30%),linear-gradient(180deg,#0d0d0f,#0a0a0b);border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
.quiz-shell{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.8fr 1.2fr;gap:70px;align-items:start}
.quiz-copy h2{font-family:Georgia,"Noto Serif TC",serif;font-size:clamp(40px,4.7vw,60px);line-height:1.03;margin:14px 0 18px}.quiz-title-main{display:block;white-space:nowrap}
.quiz-copy h2 em{display:block;color:var(--gold2);font-style:normal}
.quiz-copy p{color:#aaa59e;max-width:470px}
.quiz-meta{display:flex;gap:34px;margin-top:28px;padding-top:22px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);align-items:flex-end}.quiz-meta div{display:flex;flex-direction:row;align-items:flex-end;gap:9px;min-width:auto}.quiz-meta b{display:block;font-size:46px;line-height:.82;color:var(--gold2);font-family:"Times New Roman",Times,serif;font-variant-numeric:lining-nums;font-feature-settings:"lnum" 1}.quiz-meta span{display:block;font-size:13px;line-height:1;color:#aaa59d;margin:0 0 2px;letter-spacing:.02em}
.quiz-card{min-height:500px;padding:32px;border:1px solid rgba(216,177,94,.2);border-radius:26px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(216,177,94,.04),rgba(255,255,255,.015)),#121214;box-shadow:0 28px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}
.quiz-start{min-height:430px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
.quiz-start-badge{display:inline-flex;align-self:flex-start;padding:7px 10px;border:1px solid rgba(216,177,94,.3);border-radius:999px;color:var(--gold2);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.15em;margin-bottom:20px}
.quiz-start h3{font-family:Georgia,"Noto Serif TC",serif;font-size:38px;line-height:1.15;margin:0 0 12px}
.quiz-start p{color:#9c978f;max-width:580px;margin:0 0 26px}
.quiz-progress-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-bottom:12px}.quiz-progress-top span{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;color:#817c75}.quiz-progress-top b{font-size:11px;color:var(--gold2)}
.quiz-progress{height:3px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:30px}.quiz-progress i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#a8792e,var(--gold2));transition:.3s}
.quiz-context{display:block;color:#827d76;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;margin-bottom:8px}.quiz-question{font-size:25px;line-height:1.45;margin:0 0 22px}
.quiz-options{display:grid;gap:10px}.quiz-option{width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;text-align:left;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);border-radius:15px;padding:15px 17px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);color:#ddd8cf;transition:.2s}.quiz-option:hover{transform:translateX(4px);border-color:rgba(216,177,94,.36);background:rgba(216,177,94,.055)}.quiz-option span{display:grid;place-items:center;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(216,177,94,.28);color:var(--gold2);font-family:Georgia,serif}.quiz-option b{font-size:13px}
.quiz-result{display:none;text-align:center;padding:10px 0}.quiz-result.show{display:block}.result-ring{width:145px;height:145px;margin:8px auto 20px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(216,177,94,.4);box-shadow:inset 0 0 50px rgba(216,177,94,.06)}.result-ring strong{display:block;font-size:46px;line-height:1;color:var(--gold2);font-family:Georgia,serif}.result-ring span{font-size:9px;color:#77736d;letter-spacing:.13em}.result-level{font-size:10px;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.16em}.quiz-result h3{font-family:Georgia,"Noto Serif TC",serif;font-size:37px;margin:7px 0}.quiz-result>p{max-width:610px;margin:0 auto;color:#aaa59d}.result-recommend{max-width:620px;margin:22px auto 0;padding:18px 20px;border:1px solid rgba(216,177,94,.18);border-radius:17px;background:rgba(216,177,94,.035);text-align:left}.result-recommend small{font-size:9px;color:#77736d;letter-spacing:.12em}.result-recommend b{display:block;color:var(--gold2);font-size:18px;margin:3px 0}.result-recommend span{font-size:12px;color:#99948d}.result-actions{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:10px;margin-top:22px}
@media(max-width:980px){.quiz-shell{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:36px}}
@media(max-width:640px){.quiz-title-main{white-space:normal}.quiz-section{padding:74px 0}.quiz-card{padding:22px}.quiz-question{font-size:21px}.result-actions{flex-direction:column}.result-actions .btn{width:100%}}


.sim-section{
  position:relative;
  padding:108px 0;
  overflow:hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 18% 22%,rgba(216,177,94,.08),transparent 31%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 86% 72%,rgba(120,91,45,.08),transparent 28%),
    #0a0a0b;
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);
}
.sim-head{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr .9fr;
  gap:70px;
  align-items:end;
  margin-bottom:48px;
}
.sim-head h2{
  font-family:Georgia,"Noto Serif TC",serif;
  font-size:clamp(42px,5vw,66px);
  line-height:1.03;
  letter-spacing:-.04em;
  margin:14px 0 0;
}
.sim-head h2 em{
  display:block;
  color:var(--gold2);
  font-style:normal;
}
.sim-head-copy{
  color:#99948c;
  max-width:500px;
  justify-self:end;
  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.9;
}
.sim-shell{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:320px 1fr;
  gap:22px;
  align-items:stretch;
}
.sim-sidebar,
.sim-phone{
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  background:rgba(18,18,20,.92);
  border-radius:26px;
  box-shadow:0 28px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
}
.sim-sidebar{padding:24px}
.sim-side-label{
  display:block;
  color:#77716a;
  font-size:9px;
  letter-spacing:.18em;
  margin-bottom:12px;
}
.sim-difficulty{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  padding:14px 15px;
  border:1px solid rgba(216,177,94,.16);
  border-radius:14px;
  background:rgba(216,177,94,.04);
  margin-bottom:22px;
}
.sim-difficulty b{
  color:var(--gold2);
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:600;
}
.sim-difficulty span{
  color:#8f887e;
  font-size:10px;
}
.sim-meters{display:grid;gap:16px}
.sim-meter-top{
  display:flex;
  justify-content:space-between;
  align-items:center;
  gap:12px;
  margin-bottom:7px;
}
.sim-meter-top span{
  color:#aaa49b;
  font-size:11px;
}
.sim-meter-top b{
  color:#d5c6aa;
  font-size:11px;
  font-family:Georgia,serif;
}
.sim-meter{
  height:4px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  border-radius:999px;
  overflow:hidden;
}
.sim-meter i{
  display:block;
  height:100%;
  width:50%;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#80612e,var(--gold2));
  transition:width .35s ease;
}
.sim-rule{
  margin-top:24px;
  padding-top:20px;
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);
  color:#77736c;
  font-size:10px;
  line-height:1.8;
}
.sim-phone{
  min-height:670px;
  overflow:hidden;
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
}
.sim-phone-top{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:18px;
  padding:18px 22px;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.015);
}
.sim-contact{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:12px;
}
.sim-avatar{
  width:38px;
  height:38px;
  border-radius:50%;
  display:grid;
  place-items:center;
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,#2a2620,#171719);
  border:1px solid rgba(216,177,94,.24);
  color:var(--gold2);
  font-family:Georgia,serif;
  font-size:16px;
}
.sim-contact b{
  display:block;
  font-size:13px;
  color:#eee9e0;
}
.sim-contact span{
  display:block;
  font-size:9px;
  color:#6f6a63;
  margin-top:2px;
}
.sim-stage{
  color:#8d877f;
  font-size:10px;
  letter-spacing:.12em;
}
.sim-chat{
  flex:1;
  min-height:390px;
  max-height:460px;
  overflow:auto;
  padding:26px 24px 10px;
  scroll-behavior:smooth;
}
.sim-bubble-row{
  display:flex;
  margin:0 0 13px;
}
.sim-bubble-row.her{justify-content:flex-start}
.sim-bubble-row.me{justify-content:flex-end}
.sim-bubble{
  max-width:min(76%,620px);
  padding:12px 15px;
  border-radius:17px;
  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.65;
  opacity:0;
  transform:translateY(6px);
  animation:simPop .25s ease forwards;
}
.sim-bubble-row.her .sim-bubble{
  background:#232326;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  color:#ddd8cf;
  border-bottom-left-radius:5px;
}
.sim-bubble-row.me .sim-bubble{
  background:rgba(216,177,94,.12);
  border:1px solid rgba(216,177,94,.22);
  color:#e6dac3;
  border-bottom-right-radius:5px;
}
@keyframes simPop{to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.sim-typing{
  display:inline-flex;
  gap:4px;
  padding:12px 14px;
  border-radius:17px;
  background:#232326;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
}
.sim-typing i{
  width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;
  background:#817b73;
  animation:simDot 1s infinite ease-in-out;
}
.sim-typing i:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.15s}
.sim-typing i:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.3s}
@keyframes simDot{0%,60%,100%{opacity:.3}30%{opacity:1}}
.sim-choice-wrap{
  padding:18px 22px 22px;
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);
  background:#101012;
}
.sim-choice-caption{
  display:flex;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:18px;
  margin-bottom:10px;
}
.sim-choice-caption span{
  color:#77726b;
  font-size:9px;
  letter-spacing:.1em;
}
.sim-choice-caption b{
  color:#a79f94;
  font-size:9px;
  font-weight:500;
}
.sim-choices{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:9px;
}
.sim-choice{
  min-height:62px;
  padding:12px 14px;
  border-radius:13px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.085);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);
  color:#cfc9c0;
  text-align:left;
  font-size:11px;
  line-height:1.55;
  transition:.18s ease;
}
.sim-choice:hover{
  border-color:rgba(216,177,94,.35);
  background:rgba(216,177,94,.05);
  transform:translateY(-1px);
}
.sim-choice:disabled{opacity:.45;pointer-events:none}
.sim-start-card,
.sim-end-card{
  margin:auto;
  width:min(620px,calc(100% - 48px));
  text-align:center;
  padding:38px 30px;
}
.sim-start-card .sim-code,
.sim-end-card .sim-code{
  color:var(--gold);
  font-size:9px;
  letter-spacing:.18em;
}
.sim-start-card h3,
.sim-end-card h3{
  font-family:Georgia,"Noto Serif TC",serif;
  font-size:36px;
  line-height:1.2;
  margin:8px 0 12px;
}
.sim-start-card p,
.sim-end-card p{
  color:#969088;
  font-size:12px;
  line-height:1.8;
  margin:0 auto 22px;
  max-width:510px;
}
.sim-end-grade{
  font-family:Georgia,serif;
  color:var(--gold2);
  font-size:58px;
  line-height:1;
  margin:8px 0;
}
.sim-end-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
  gap:8px;
  margin:20px 0 22px;
}
.sim-end-grid div{
  padding:12px 8px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);
  border-radius:12px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.018);
}
.sim-end-grid b{
  display:block;
  color:#d9c9aa;
  font-family:Georgia,serif;
  font-size:20px;
}
.sim-end-grid span{
  display:block;
  color:#756f68;
  font-size:9px;
  margin-top:4px;
}
.sim-result-note{
  color:#aaa39a!important;
  border-left:2px solid rgba(216,177,94,.4);
  padding-left:12px;
  text-align:left;
}
@media(max-width:980px){
  .sim-head{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:22px}
  .sim-head-copy{justify-self:start}
  .sim-shell{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .sim-sidebar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.5fr;gap:20px}
  .sim-difficulty{margin:0}
  .sim-rule{grid-column:1/-1;margin-top:0}
}
@media(max-width:680px){
  .sim-section{padding:78px 0}
  .sim-sidebar{display:block}
  .sim-difficulty{margin-bottom:20px}
  .sim-rule{margin-top:22px}
  .sim-phone{min-height:720px;border-radius:20px}
  .sim-choices{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .sim-chat{max-height:430px}
  .sim-bubble{max-width:88%}
  .sim-end-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .sim-start-card h3,.sim-end-card h3{font-size:30px}
}


.interactive-lab{
  position:relative;
  padding:86px 0 74px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 18% 18%,rgba(216,177,94,.07),transparent 30%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#0c0c0e,#0a0a0b);
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);
}
.lab-head{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr .9fr;
  gap:56px;
  align-items:end;
  margin-bottom:34px;
}
.lab-head h2{
  font-family:Georgia,"Noto Serif TC",serif;
  font-size:clamp(38px,4.7vw,60px);
  line-height:1.04;
  letter-spacing:-.04em;
  margin:13px 0 0;
}
.lab-head h2 em{
  display:block;
  color:var(--gold2);
  font-style:normal;
}
.lab-head p{
  justify-self:end;
  max-width:520px;
  color:#969088;
  font-size:12px;
  line-height:1.85;
  margin:0;
}
.lab-cards{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:16px;
}
.lab-card{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
  min-height:220px;
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  justify-content:space-between;
  padding:26px 28px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.085);
  border-radius:22px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(216,177,94,.045),rgba(255,255,255,.012)),
    #121214;
  transition:.22s ease;
  cursor:pointer;
}
.lab-card:before{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  width:180px;height:180px;
  right:-80px;top:-90px;
  border-radius:50%;
  background:rgba(216,177,94,.055);
  filter:blur(2px);
}
.lab-card:hover{
  transform:translateY(-3px);
  border-color:rgba(216,177,94,.32);
  box-shadow:0 18px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.2);
}
.lab-card-top{
  display:flex;
  justify-content:space-between;
  align-items:flex-start;
  gap:20px;
}
.lab-card-index{
  color:var(--gold);
  font-family:Georgia,serif;
  font-size:11px;
  letter-spacing:.12em;
}
.lab-card-badge{
  padding:6px 9px;
  border:1px solid rgba(216,177,94,.22);
  border-radius:999px;
  color:#9f978b;
  font-size:8px;
  letter-spacing:.1em;
}
.lab-card h3{
  font-family:Georgia,"Noto Serif TC",serif;
  font-size:28px;
  line-height:1.2;
  margin:18px 0 7px;
}
.lab-card p{
  color:#8f8981;
  font-size:11px;
  line-height:1.7;
  margin:0;
  max-width:560px;
}
.lab-card-bottom{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:16px;
  margin-top:24px;
  padding-top:16px;
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
}
.lab-card-meta{
  color:#77716a;
  font-size:9px;
  letter-spacing:.08em;
}
.lab-card-cta{
  color:var(--gold2);
  font-size:11px;
  font-weight:600;
}
.quiz-section,
.sim-section{
  display:none;
}
.quiz-section.is-open,
.sim-section.is-open{
  display:block;
}
.interactive-close-wrap{
  display:flex;
  justify-content:flex-end;
  margin-bottom:18px;
}
.interactive-close{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:8px;
  padding:8px 12px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);
  border-radius:999px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.025);
  color:#938d84;
  font-size:10px;
  cursor:pointer;
  transition:.18s;
}
.interactive-close:hover{
  color:var(--gold2);
  border-color:rgba(216,177,94,.28);
}
@media(max-width:840px){
  .lab-head{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:18px}

  .lab-cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media(max-width:560px){

@media(max-width:680px){

.sim-phone{

  max-height:none!important;
  overflow:hidden!important;
  display:flex!important;
  align-items:flex-start!important;
  justify-content:center!important;
  padding:28px 24px 24px!important;
}

.sim-phone:not(.is-conversation) .sim-character-select{
  width:min(100%,860px)!important;
  max-width:860px!important;
  margin:0 auto!important;
  padding:24px 18px 18px!important;
}

/* Route intro + conversation: outer frame stays identical */
.sim-phone.is-conversation{
  height:860px!important;
  min-height:860px!important;
  max-height:860px!important;
  overflow:hidden!important;
}

/* Route intro is centered within same fixed frame */
.sim-phone.is-conversation .sim-start-card{
  margin:auto!important;
}

/* Active conversation: only message area scrolls */
.sim-phone.is-conversation .sim-chat{
  flex:1 1 auto!important;
  min-height:0!important;
  height:auto!important;
  max-height:none!important;
  overflow-y:auto!important;
  overflow-x:hidden!important;

}

/* Choices remain fixed at bottom */
.sim-phone.is-conversation .sim-choice-wrap{

}

/* Keep selector cards inside the unified frame */

<button class="btn ghost" data-scroll="#courses">先看單堂課</button>
</div>

</div>
</section>


<section class="interactive-lab" id="interactive-lab">
  <div class="section-shell">
    <div class="lab-head reveal">
      <div>
        <span class="eyebrow"><span></span> INTERACTIVE LAB</span>
        <h2>先別急著上課，<em>先看看你撐不撐得住。</em></h2>
      </div>

const modal = document.getElementById('courseModal');
const modalContent = document.getElementById('modalContent');
const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
document.querySelectorAll('[data-img]').forEach(img=>{img.src=COURSE_IMAGES[img.dataset.img]||'';});

function openCourse(key){
  const c = courseData[key];
  if(!c) return;
  modalContent.innerHTML = `
    <img class="modal-hero-img" src="${c.image}" alt="${c.title}海報">
    <span class="modal-kicker">${c.kicker}</span>
    <h2 id="modalTitle">${c.title}</h2>
    <div class="modal-teacher">講師｜${c.teacher}・永久觀看</div>
    <p>${c.desc}</p>
    <div class="modal-modules">
      ${c.modules.map(m=>`<div class="module"><span>${m[0]}</span><b>${m[1]}</b><small>${m[2]}</small></div>`).join('')}
    </div>
    <div class="modal-price"><strong>${c.price}</strong><button data-cart="${key}">加入課程 →</button></div>`;
  modal.classList.add('open');
  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
  document.body.style.overflow='hidden';
  modalContent.querySelector('[data-cart]').addEventListener('click', showToast);
}

function closeModal(){
  modal.classList.remove('open');
  modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
  document.body.style.overflow='';
}

function showToast(){
  toast.classList.add('show');
  clearTimeout(window.toastTimer);
  window.toastTimer = setTimeout(()=>toast.classList.remove('show'),2600);
}

document.querySelectorAll('[data-open]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>openCourse(btn.dataset.open)));
document.querySelectorAll('[data-close]').forEach(el=>el.addEventListener('click',closeModal));
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')closeModal()});
document.querySelectorAll('[data-cart]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',showToast));
document.querySelectorAll('[data-scroll]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  document.querySelector(btn.dataset.scroll)?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});
}));

const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries)=>{
  entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('visible');io.unobserve(e.target)}})
},{threshold:.12});
document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el=>io.observe(el));

// Make details indicator react naturally without extra dependencies.
document.querySelectorAll('details').forEach(d=>{
  d.addEventListener('toggle',()=>{
    if(d.open){
      document.querySelectorAll('details').forEach(other=>{if(other!==d) other.open=false});
    }
  });
});

</script>

   txt="不用回頭找是哪一題答錯了。這是 50% 隨機娛樂彩蛋，跟你的作答內容與真實性向完全無關。";
 }else if(pct>=93){
   lv="LEVEL 04・極稀有樣本";
   title="高功能直男";
   txt="你幾乎每次都能在界線、情緒、場合與關係成本之間找到平衡。這個分數不是因為你懂標準答案，而是因為你很少只看一個原則。";
 }else if(pct>=84){
   lv="LEVEL 03・艱難進化";
   title="進化中的直男";
   txt="你已經能處理大部分模糊情境，但在高壓、雙重期待或公開場合裡仍可能失手。這個等級刻意設得很難，不是隨便選幾個好聽答案就能拿到。";
 }else if(pct>=66){
   lv="LEVEL 02・典型高壓樣本";
   title="標準直男";
   txt="你的多數答案都有道理，但這套測驗考的不是有沒有道理，而是能不能同時處理情緒、界線與場合。少看一層，就很容易在現實裡踩雷。";
 }else{
   lv="LEVEL 01・原廠設定";
   title="純種直男";
   txt="你不是不會思考，而是比較常選擇最直接、最有效率或最符合單一原則的做法。可惜高壓關係與人際場合，往往專門處罰這種答案。";
 }

 const ratios=Object.entries(dims).map(([k,v])=>[k,v/dimMax[k]]).sort((a,b)=>a[1]-b[1]);
 const weak=ratios[0][0];
 let course,reason;

 if(rainbowBranch){
   course="SYSTEM RESULT・甲甲支線";
   reason="恭喜觸發 50% 隨機彩蛋。建議先截圖丟群組，再回來重測一次。";
   target="#quiz";
 }else if(weak==="boundary"){
   course="《高效撇除責任心課》";
   reason="你比較容易在顧慮關係時讓自己的界線變模糊。真正難的不是拒絕，而是拒絕之後關係還能正常運作。";
   target="#courses";
 }else if(weak==="relation"){
   course="《多線關係管理學》";
   reason="你的主要弱項是關係節奏與期待管理。很多高難度情境都沒有完美回答，只能靠事前建立規則降低誤解。";
   target="#courses";
 }else if(weak==="frame"){
   course="《男性主導權養成課》";
   reason="你需要的不是更強勢，而是在矛盾期待與雙重標準裡仍然能保留自己的判斷。";
   target="#courses";
 }else{
   course="《高階直男養成術》";
   reason="你的弱點主要落在情緒、社交場合或自我呈現。這些題目最難的地方，通常不是答案本身，而是時機與語氣。";
   target="#straightman";
 }

 document.getElementById("resultScore").textContent=pct;
 document.getElementById("resultLevel").textContent=lv;
 document.getElementById("resultTitle").textContent=title;
 document.getElementById("resultText").textContent=txt;
 document.getElementById("resultCourse").textContent=course;
 document.getElementById("resultReason").textContent=reason;
 res.classList.add("show");
}

function reset(){
 i=0;total=0;
 dims={emotion:0,boundary:0,relation:0,frame:0,camera:0,charm:0};
 res.classList.remove("show");
 start.style.display="flex";
 flow.style.display="none";
 document.getElementById("quizProgress").style.width="0%";
}

s.onclick=()=>{
 i=0;total=0;
 dims={emotion:0,boundary:0,relation:0,frame:0,camera:0,charm:0};
 start.style.display="none";
 flow.style.display="block";
 render();
};

document.getElementById("restartQuiz").onclick=reset;
document.getElementById("resultGoCourse").onclick=()=>{const el=document.querySelector(target);if(el)el.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth"});};
})();
</script>


<script>

             reply:"你為什麼一直避開『第一順位』？是因為你其實不覺得伴侶應該最重要嗎？"},

    },

    mimi:{

          options:[

            {t:"我願意冒風險，但前提是那不是臨時證明感情，而是我們真的共同做出的決定。",d:{emotion:4,boundary:3,frame:4,social:0}}
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  };

  function clamp(v){ return Math.max(0,Math.min(100,v)); }

  function updateMeters(){
    [
      ["emotion","simEmotionNum","simEmotionBar"],
      ["boundary","simBoundaryNum","simBoundaryBar"],
      ["frame","simFrameNum","simFrameBar"],
      ["social","simSocialNum","simSocialBar"]
    ].forEach(([key,n,b])=>{
      const v=Math.round(stats[key]);
      const num=document.getElementById(n);
      const bar=document.getElementById(b);
      if(num) num.textContent=v;
      if(bar) bar.style.width=v+"%";
    });
  }

  function addBubble(who,text){
    const row=document.createElement("div");
    row.className="sim-bubble-row "+who;
    row.innerHTML='<div class="sim-bubble">'+text+'</div>';
    chat.appendChild(row);
    chat.scrollTop=chat.scrollHeight;
  }

  function typingThen(text,cb){
    const row=document.createElement("div");
    row.className="sim-bubble-row her";
    row.innerHTML='<div class="sim-typing"><i></i><i></i><i></i></div>';
    chat.appendChild(row);
    chat.scrollTop=chat.scrollHeight;
    setTimeout(()=>{
      row.remove();
      addBubble("her",text);
      if(cb) cb();
    },650);
  }

  function characterSelectHTML(){
    return `
      <div class="sim-character-select">
        <span class="sim-code">CHOOSE YOUR SCENARIO・選擇主角</span>
        <h3>今天你想挑戰哪一位？</h3>
        <p>不是同一套題目換名字。你將扮演育哲，進入兩段完全不同的關係情境。兩位女主角都有各自的事件、對話節奏與踩雷方式；選定後才會開始計分。</p>
        <div class="sim-character-grid">

          <button class="sim-character" data-sim-character="qiqi">
            <div class="sim-character-photo">
              <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="齊齊角色照片">
            </div>
            <div class="sim-character-content">
              <div class="sim-character-head">
                <div>
                  <span class="sim-character-name">齊齊</span>
                  <span class="sim-character-age">25 歲</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="sim-character-desc">擅長把一句普通問題，變成價值觀、在乎程度與記憶力的綜合考題。</div>
              <div class="sim-character-footer">
                <span>隱性期待・承諾・價值衝突</span>
                <b>HIGH RISK</b>
              </div>
            </div>
          </button>

          <button class="sim-character" data-sim-character="mimi">
            <div class="sim-character-photo">
              <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="小咪角色照片">
            </div>
            <div class="sim-character-content">
              <div class="sim-character-head">
                <div>
                  <span class="sim-character-name">小咪</span>
                  <span class="sim-character-age">25 歲</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="sim-character-desc">親密關係裡最難的不是敢不敢，而是當氣氛到了，你還能不能把同意、避孕與彼此安全講清楚。</div>
              <div class="sim-character-footer">
                <span>親密界線・避孕風險・信任拉扯</span>
                <b>HIGH RISK</b>
              </div>
            </div>
          </button>

        </div>
      </div>`;
  }

  function showCharacterSelect(){
    if(simPhone) simPhone.removeAttribute("data-character");
    if(simPhone) simPhone.classList.remove("is-conversation");
    activeCharacter=null;
    turn=0;
    stats={emotion:50,boundary:50,frame:50,social:50};
    history=[];
    updateMeters();
    choiceWrap.style.display="none";
    stage.textContent="SIMULATION READY";
    contactName.textContent="選擇主角";
    contactStatus.textContent="READY・等待選擇";
    avatar.textContent="?";
    chat.innerHTML=characterSelectHTML();
  }

  function chooseCharacter(key){
    if(simPhone) simPhone.setAttribute("data-character", key);
    if(simPhone) simPhone.classList.add("is-conversation");
    activeCharacter=key;
    turn=0;
    stats={emotion:50,boundary:50,frame:50,social:50};
    history=[];
    updateMeters();

    const s=scenarios[key];
    contactName.textContent=s.name;
    contactStatus.textContent="線上・正在輸入";
    avatar.textContent=s.avatar;
    stage.textContent=s.route;

    choiceWrap.style.display="none";
    chat.innerHTML=`
      <div class="sim-start-card">
        <span class="sim-route-tag">${s.name} ROUTE・${s.route}</span>
        <span class="sim-code">YOU ARE YUZHE・SCENARIO READY・5 TURNS</span>
        <h3>${s.introTitle}</h3>
        <p>${s.intro}</p>
        <button class="btn primary" id="simRouteStart">開始 ${s.name} 線 <span>→</span></button>
      </div>`;
    document.getElementById("simRouteStart").onclick=startRoute;
  }

  function startRoute(){
    if(simPhone) simPhone.classList.add("is-conversation");
    turn=0;
    stats={emotion:50,boundary:50,frame:50,social:50};
    history=[];
    updateMeters();
    chat.innerHTML="";
    choiceWrap.style.display="none";
    renderTurn();
  }

  function renderTurn(){
    const route=scenarios[activeCharacter];
    const data=route.turns[turn];
    stage.textContent=route.name.toUpperCase()+" ROUTE・TURN "+String(turn+1).padStart(2,"0");
    turnHint.textContent="回合 "+(turn+1)+" / "+route.turns.length;
    typingThen(data.her,showChoices);
  }

  function showChoices(){
    const data=scenarios[activeCharacter].turns[turn];
    choices.innerHTML="";
    data.options.forEach((o,idx)=>{
      const btn=document.createElement("button");
      btn.className="sim-choice";
      btn.textContent=o.t;
      btn.onclick=()=>selectChoice(o,idx);
      choices.appendChild(btn);
    });
    choiceWrap.style.display="block";
  }

  function selectChoice(o,idx){
    choices.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b=>b.disabled=true);
    addBubble("me",o.t);
    history.push({turn,index:idx,text:o.t});
    Object.entries(o.d).forEach(([k,v])=>stats[k]=clamp(stats[k]+v));
    updateMeters();

    const route=scenarios[activeCharacter];
    const after=()=>{
      turn++;
      if(turn>=route.turns.length){
        setTimeout(showEnd,500);
      }else{
        setTimeout(renderTurn,350);
      }
    };

    if(o.reply){
      typingThen(o.reply,after);
    }else{
      after();
    }
  }

  function evaluate(){
    const vals=Object.values(stats);
    const avg=vals.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/vals.length;
    const spread=Math.max(...vals)-Math.min(...vals);

    let grade,title,note;

    if(activeCharacter==="qiqi"){
      if(avg>=57.5 && spread<=8){
        grade="S";
        title="幾乎不可能的完美路線";
        note="你不只把平均分拉高，四項能力還維持得非常平衡。齊齊線能走到這裡，已經屬於極少數路徑。";
      }else if(avg>=57 && spread<=10){
        grade="A";
        title="極限生還";
        note="你幾乎每一回合都避開了最傷的交換條件，而且沒有嚴重偏科。這不是普通的『會講話』就能拿到。";
      }else if(avg>=56.75 && spread<=12){
        grade="B";
        title="勉強脫身";
        note="你整體處理得不差，但還是留下幾個可以被追問的洞。齊齊線的 B 已經算少見。";
      }else if(avg>=55){
        grade="C";
        title="高機率進入檢討會";
        note="這是齊齊線最常見的結果。你的回答可能每句都說得通，但她總能從另一個角度抓到新的問題。";
      }else{
        grade="D";
        title="今晚先不要再解釋";
        note="你不是每題都答錯，而是累積下來的交換成本太高。現在越補充，越容易再被抓到下一個矛盾。";
      }
    }else{
      if(avg>=58.75 && spread<=2){
        grade="S";
        title="親密界線天花板";
        note="你幾乎同時顧到親密感、界線、安全與雙方承擔，而且四項數值非常平衡。這條路線非常罕見。";
      }else if(avg>=58.5 && spread<=4){
        grade="A";
        title="極限生還";
        note="你在高壓親密議題裡幾乎沒有留下明顯破口。小咪線能拿 A，已經代表界線與風險判斷非常穩。";
      }else if(avg>=58 && spread<=6){
        grade="B";
        title="勉強安全離場";
        note="你大部分時候都有顧到彼此，但仍有幾次讓親密感、安全或界線其中一項被犧牲。這個版本的 B 已經不是普通結果。";
      }else if(avg>=56.25){
        grade="C";
        title="回家後需要檢討";
        note="這是小咪線最常見的結果。你可能顧到氣氛，卻犧牲安全；或守住風險，卻讓她感覺被拒絕。";
      }else{
        grade="D";
        title="親密談判已失守";
        note="沒有哪一句特別離譜，但整體節奏讓你在親密、信任、避孕與界線之間反覆失血。高機率還有第二回合。";
      }
    }

    return {grade,title,note,avg,spread};
  }

  function showEnd(){
    if(simPhone) simPhone.classList.add("is-conversation");
    choiceWrap.style.display="none";
    const route=scenarios[activeCharacter];
    stage.textContent=route.name.toUpperCase()+" ROUTE・COMPLETE";
    const r=evaluate();

    chat.innerHTML=`
      <div class="sim-end-card">
        <span class="sim-code">AFTER ACTION REPORT・${route.name}線</span>
        <div class="sim-end-grade">${r.grade}</div>
        <h3>${r.title}</h3>
        <p class="sim-result-note">${r.note}<br><br>${route.endFlavor}</p>
        <div class="sim-end-grid">
          <div><b>${Math.round(stats.emotion)}</b><span>情緒價值</span></div>
          <div><b>${Math.round(stats.boundary)}</b><span>界線感</span></div>
          <div><b>${Math.round(stats.frame)}</b><span>主導力</span></div>
          <div><b>${Math.round(stats.social)}</b><span>判斷力</span></div>
        </div>
        <div class="sim-end-actions">
          <button class="btn primary" id="simRestartSame">重玩 ${route.name} 線 <span>↻</span></button>
          <button class="btn ghost" id="simSwitchCharacter">挑戰另一位</button>
        </div>
      </div>`;

    document.getElementById("simRestartSame").onclick=()=>chooseCharacter(activeCharacter);
    document.getElementById("simSwitchCharacter").onclick=showCharacterSelect;
  }

  chat.addEventListener("click",(e)=>{
    const card=e.target.closest("[data-sim-character]");
    if(card) chooseCharacter(card.getAttribute("data-sim-character"));
  });

  showCharacterSelect();
})();
</script>


<script>
(function(){
  const hub = document.getElementById("interactive-lab");
  const quiz = document.getElementById("quiz");
  const simulator = document.getElementById("simulator");
  const map = {quiz, simulator};

  function openPanel(key){
    Object.values(map).forEach(el => {
      if(el) el.classList.remove("is-open");
    });
    const target = map[key];
    if(!target) return;
    target.classList.add("is-open");
    setTimeout(()=>{
      target.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth", block:"start"});
    },40);
  }

  function closePanels(){
    Object.values(map).forEach(el => {
      if(el) el.classList.remove("is-open");
    });
    if(hub){
      setTimeout(()=>hub.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth", block:"start"}),30);
    }
  }

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-open-interactive]").forEach(card=>{
    const key = card.getAttribute("data-open-interactive");
    card.addEventListener("click",()=>openPanel(key));
    card.addEventListener("keydown",(e)=>{
      if(e.key==="Enter" || e.key===" "){
        e.preventDefault();
        openPanel(key);
      }
    });
  });

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-close-interactive]").forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener("click",closePanels);
  });
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>
